text: {"language":"en","sentences":[{"text":"While shopping for a birthday cake, Maya was surprised to run into her former teacher at the bakery.","hint":"Maya did not expect to see her teacher there.","translation":"While shopping for a birthday cake, Maya unexpectedly met her former teacher at the bakery.","level":"intermediate","skill":"meaningInContext","check":{"question":"What does 'run into' mean in this context?","choices":["Meet unexpectedly","Chase someone quickly","Make a plan to visit"],"correctIndex":0,"explanation":"Maya was surprised to see her former teacher, so 'run into' means to meet someone unexpectedly."}},{"text":"At the conference, Leo hoped to run into a colleague he hadn't seen in years, though they hadn't arranged to meet.","hint":"Think about a meeting that has not been planned.","translation":"At the conference, Leo hoped to meet a colleague unexpectedly, although they had made no plans to meet.","level":"intermediate","skill":"meaningInContext","check":{"question":"How is 'run into' used in this context?","choices":["To describe avoiding a colleague","To describe meeting a colleague by chance","To describe contacting a colleague online"],"correctIndex":1,"explanation":"Leo hopes to see his colleague by chance because they have not arranged a meeting."}}]}
